Notes
-----

.. container:: note-item

   As a point on the Euler line, :ref:`X_381 <X_381>` has Shinagawa coefficients :math:`(1,3)`.

.. container:: note-item

   Let :g:`A' <A'>` be the reflection of :ref:`X_3 <X_3>` in :g:`A <A>`, and define B'and :g:`C' <C'>` cyclically. Let :g:`A″ <A″>` be the reflection of :ref:`X_3 <X_3>` in :g:`BC <[ B C ]>`, and define :g:`B″ <B″>` and :g:`C″ <C″>` cyclically. The lines :g:`A'A″ <[ A' A″ ]>`, :g:`B'B″ <[ B' B″ ]>`, :g:`C'C″ <[ C' C″ ]>` concur in :ref:`X_381 <X_381>`.

.. container:: note-item

   Let :g:`P_{a} <P_a>` be the parabola with focus A and directrix :g:`BC <[ B C ]>`. Let :g:`L_{a} <L_a>` be the polar of :ref:`X_3 <X_3>` wrt :g:`P_{a} <P_a>`. Define :g:`L_{b} <L_b>` and :g:`L_{c} <L_c>` cyclically. Let :g:`A' <A'>` = :g:`L_{b} <L_b>`\ ∩\ :g:`L_{c} <L_c>`, :g:`B' <B'>` = :g:`L_{c} <L_c>`\ ∩\ :g:`L_{a} <L_a>`, :g:`C' <C'>` = :g:`L_{a} <L_a>`\ ∩\ :g:`L_{b} <L_b>`. The symmedian point of triangle :g:`A'B'C' << A' B' C' >>` is :ref:`X_381 <X_381>`. Analogously, let :g:`L_{a} <L_a>` be the :term:`trilinear polar <trilinear-polar>` of :g:`A <A>` wrt :g:`BC <[ B C ]>`\ :ref:`X_3 <X_3>`, and define :g:`L_{b} <L_b>` and :g:`L_{c} <L_c>` cyclically. Let :g:`A' <A'>`\ =\ :g:`L_{b} <L_b>`\ ∩\ :g:`L_{c} <L_c>`, :g:`B' <B'>`\ =\ :g:`L_{c} <L_c>`\ ∩\ :g:`L_{a} <L_a>`, :g:`C' <C'>`\ =\ :g:`L_{a} <L_a>`\ ∩\ :g:`L_{b} <L_b>`. Equivalently, :g:`A'B'C' << A' B' C' >>` is the :term:`cevian triangle <cevian-triangle>` of :ref:`X_3 <X_3>` wrt the cevian triangle of :ref:`X_3 <X_3>`. Also, let :g:`A″ <A″>` be the reflection of :g:`A' <A'>` in :g:`BC <[ B C ]>`, and define :g:`B″ <B″>` and :g:`C″ <C″>` cyclically. The lines :g:`AA″ <[ A A″ ]>`, :g:`BB″ <[ B B″ ]>`, :g:`CC″ <[ C C″ ]>` concur in :ref:`X_381 <X_381>`. Finally, let :g:`A' <A'>` be the orthocenter of :g:`BC <[ B C ]>`\ :ref:`X_6 <X_6>`, and define :g:`B' <B'>` and :g:`C' <C'>` cyclically; then :ref:`X_381 <X_381>` is the centroid of :g:`A'B'C' << A' B' C' >>`. (:person:`Randy Hutson <randy-hutson>`, September 5, 2015)

.. container:: note-item

   Let :g:`S_{a} <S_a>` be the similitude center of the orthocentroidal triangle and the A-altimedial triangle. Define :g:`S_{b} <S_b>` and :g:`S_{c} <S_c>` cyclically. The lines :g:`AS_{a} <[ A S_a ]>`, :g:`BS_{b} <[ B S_b ]>`, :g:`CS_{c} <[ C S_c ]>` concur in :ref:`X_381 <X_381>`. (Randy Hutson, December 10, 2016)

.. container:: note-item

   Let :g:`A_{1}B_{1}C_{1} << A_1 B_1 C_1 >>` and :g:`A_{2}B_{2}C_{2} << A_2 B_2 C_2 >>` be the 1st and 2nd Ehrmann circumscribing triangles. Let :g:`A' <A'>` be the crosspoint of :g:`A_{1} <A_1>` and :g:`A_{2} <A_2>`, and define :g:`B' <B'>`, :g:`C' <C'>` cyclically. The lines :g:`AA' <[ A A' ]>`, :g:`BB' <[ B B' ]>`, :g:`CC' <[ C C' ]>` concur in :ref:`X_381 <X_381>`. (Randy Hutson, June 27, 2018)
